description: About goa activity. Goa is so much more than just sun and sand. It's a vibrant blend of thrilling adventure, rich history, and serene natural beauty.East meets West in this sun-soaked state, where Indian culture intertwines with Portuguese influences left over from a 500-year occupation.Ah, Goa! The very name conjures up images of sun-kissed beaches, swaying palm trees, and a laid-back vibe that is as contagious as a beachside melody.Goa, a tiny emerald land on the west coast of India, the 25th state of the Union states of India, was liberated from Portuguese rule in 1961.
